description: Department of Election - Presidential Elections Act, No.15 of 1981. Notice Under Sub Section 31 (4) (Amended Gazette Extra No.2397/52 Dated 15.08.2024)
reasoning: This gazette content pertains specifically to electoral processes for a presidential election. It contains a notice under the Presidential Election Act regarding amendments to election agent details for candidates, including their names, addresses, and political affiliations. The document is issued by the Election Commission and relates to the administration of an upcoming presidential election, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
